mainEntity.name: How often should residential air ducts be cleaned?

acceptedAnswer.text: According to National Air Duct Cleaners Association (NADCA) guidelines, typical residential ductwork should be inspected every two years and thoroughly cleaned every three to five years.

mainEntity.name: Will dust or dirt blow into my living room during cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Certified technicians seal every supply and return register grille throughout your home with airtight protective covers before starting work under continuous negative air pressure.

mainEntity.name: How long does a thorough residential duct cleaning take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete whole-home decontamination for a typical two thousand to twenty-five hundred square-foot Rockford home requires three to four and a half hours.

mainEntity.name: Are the antimicrobial fogging solutions safe for children and pets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We apply an EPA-registered botanical antimicrobial fog derived from natural oil of thyme that leaves zero synthetic VOCs or chemical residues.
